maps.name: Crypt of the Ashen Saint
maps.description: A sprawling crypt under a ruined chapel: catacombs, ossuary, flooded gallery, trapped processional, hidden reliquary and the saint's warded tomb.

maps.name: The Flooded Chapel
maps.description: A whole temple complex swallowed by the sea: wade the flooded nave, search the scriptorium, cloister and drowned garden, brave the whirlpool cistern or the smugglers' tunnel, and go down into the drowned crypt where the abbot waits.

maps.name: Forest Road Ambush
maps.description: A long stretch of forest road: the wagon ambush at the narrows, a cut bridge and a ford, the bandits' palisade camp, a hunter's lodge, a marsh, standing stones with a hidden barrow, and the bandit captain's hideout in the cliffs behind the waterfall.

maps.name: Goblin Warren
maps.description: A goblin tribe's whole hillside cave system: a ravine approach and watch post, a bat roost, the sleeping den on an underground stream, the feasting cave, a shaman's hollow, a smithy, worg kennels, a wolf pen, the prisoners' hole, an underground river, an old dwarven mine and the chief's hall with a hidden hoard. Three routes lead to the chief.

maps.name: The Rusty Flagon (ground floor)
maps.description: A busy roadside tavern: common room with bar and hearth, a private snug, a kitchen, a storeroom with a cellar trapdoor and a locked back door, all facing a cobbled street.

maps.name: The Rusty Flagon (upstairs)
maps.description: Upstairs at the Rusty Flagon: a landing hall, five rented rooms and the innkeeper's locked quarters.

maps.name: The Wizard's Tower
maps.description: A wizard's whole walled estate: gate and courtyard, hedge garden with a rotating-statue puzzle, greenhouse, observatory, stables and roost, apprentices' quarters, the round tower with its library, alchemy lab and summoning sanctum, a secret study behind a hinged bookcase, and a trapped cellar of runes, a vault and a portal room where the master waits.

rooms.name: Cave pool
rooms.description: A natural cave with a still pool and glowing mushrooms.

rooms.name: Collapsed hall
rooms.description: Half the ceiling is down: rubble, boulders and a narrow path.

rooms.name: Guard post
rooms.description: Bunks, a table and a weapon rack for 4 guards.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves along the walls, a reading desk and a lectern.

rooms.name: Mess hall
rooms.description: Long tables and a kitchen hearth.

rooms.name: Prison cells
rooms.description: Three barred cells off a guard walk.

rooms.name: Ritual chamber
rooms.description: A rune circle ringed by braziers.

rooms.name: Small shrine
rooms.description: A pillared shrine with an altar and candles. Two doorways, north and south.

rooms.name: Smithy
rooms.description: Forge, anvil and a rack of fresh blades.

rooms.name: Storeroom
rooms.description: Crates, barrels and sacks; good for hiding things.

rooms.name: Throne room
rooms.description: A long hall of pillars leading to a dais and throne.

rooms.name: Treasure vault
rooms.description: A locked vault with a chest, coins and a trap.
